title: Parse a structured log line
description: Implement parse_log_line(line). Parse one log line of the exact form 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS [LEVEL] message' into a dict with keys 'date', 'time', 'level', 'message'. Fields are separated by single spaces. LEVEL must be one of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL (uppercase). The date must be a valid calendar date and the time a valid 24-hour clock time; both must use the exact widths shown (zero-padded). The message is everything after the level bracket, may itself contain spaces and bracket characters, and must be non-empty. Leading and trailing whitespace on the whole line is ignored. Raise ValueError on any deviation.
invariants: Single-space separators only: a double space between fields is a ValueError.
Exact widths: '2026-1-1 02:03:04 [INFO] x' is a ValueError even though the date is real.
Invalid dates and times are ValueError: month 13, February 30, hour 24, minute 60.
Unknown or lowercase levels are ValueError: '[TRACE]', '[info]'.
The message keeps everything after the third field verbatim, including '[' and ']' characters.
An empty message is a ValueError.
